results.title: Introzy launches Zero integration to keep referrals connected to deals
results.content:
CHICAGO, Sept. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire-PRWeb/ -- Introzy, the platform that tracks referrals from the introduction through the payout, today announced an integration with Zero, the CRM Introzy's own team has used to run its go-to-market for months. A referral tracked in Introzy now appears automatically on the matching deal record in Zero, with the person who made the introduction still attached. [...] Introzy holds the middle of the referral: who made the introduction, what it turned into, and who is owed for it. Zero helps teams run their go-to-market with AI, keeping customer context and deal activity up to date. The integration connects the two directly, so a referral entered in Introzy syncs to the matching deal in Zero without anyone re-entering it, and the connector's name travels with it onto the record. [...] The integration is available today to Introzy customers running on Zero. 

About Introzy

Introzy is a PartnerOps platform that brings partner relationship management to the SMB market, turning manual, spreadsheet-driven referral programs into a system for introductions, attribution, and payouts.

results.title: The Startup Wildlink Says It Has Found a Way to Monetize Referrals - Business Insider
results.content:
Rather than banner ads or TV commercials, it is often word-of-mouth referrals from friends and family that drive consumers to make a purchase.

But there hasn't really been a way for brands to track those real-world referrals. Nor has there been much of a tangible benefit for consumers to provide them — until now. [...] Unlike existing rebate services, which give cash back for users' own shopping, it aims to reward users for suggestions they share with others. Those who sign up also have access to a dashboard where they can track the earnings from their recommendations, from which they can make 5 to 25% commission. [...] According to Glazier, Wildlink can automatically detect product referrals using natural language processing and transform them into trackable links, which can be shared across email, text messages, social media, and other peer-to-peer chat platforms like WhatsApp.

These links, when clicked, allow the sender to make money if the receiver ends up making a purchase from participating brands, Glazier said. All users have to do is download the Wildlink app on iOS or Android or on their desktops.

Sarah Perez

4 min read [...] When you click on a link shared on Bluesky, you'll notice that it briefly displays as a "go.bsky.app" URL before landing you on the publisher's own domain. This allows publishers' analytics systems to determine that the visitor came from Bluesky.

Liu notes in a post on Bluesky that the change came about because newsrooms were seeing engagement from likes and reposts in the app but had a harder time determining how that was translating into "actual website traffic."
